about: Seeds of compiler/test/fuzz.test.ts (C101) kept because a run found a difference at them (T18b). Each: the seed, the date found, the row that fixes it. fuzz.test.ts runs seed 1 and each of these, a kept one as a todo until its row is done, then as a test (`fixed` names the row); remove one once the definition it showed has its own test.
